implementation.scope: Replace temporary Vec<Publication> in memory/IPC authority publication with stable borrowed iterator providers. No batch-sized heap or stack buffer; complete prepared scalar call commit now needs no heap.
implementation.batch_contract: PublicationBatch must enumerate identical destinations, sources and dispositions on both passes, without allocation, membership mutation, callbacks or subsystem entry. Slice/array and TransferPublications providers reborrow existing disjoint owner fields. SourceDisposition is Copy policy; authority/escrow/roots/pins/charges are not cloned.
implementation.gate: One CAPABILITIES hold spans validation of every captured account/kind/state and the mutation pass. Late rejection publishes no authority. Existing source actions revoke moves into retained metadata and restore loan authority.
implementation.memory: Validate prepared payloads under MEMORY_OBJECTS before the authority gate. Keep that guard through later payload updates. Scalar-only calls skip the memory registry. Existing checked combined-length arithmetic and 255-entry packed memory limit remain unchanged.
implementation.ownership: Borrowed views own no cleanup. Existing containing roots, pins, private copied frames, escrow and original charges remain live. Ordinary unstarted rejection uses existing prepared-owner cancellation; no cleanup/replay authority follows from timeout/readiness/absence.

controls.mixed_heap_scope: Actual authority provider and gate only; heap released before existing memory payload-map updates.
